about.heading:
A Voice For
The Late Set
paragraphs: Based on Vancouver Island, Mel McCutcheon has become a familiar fixture in the region's jazz rooms. Her rich, warm voice has drawn comparisons to Nina Simone, Carmen McRae, and Ernestine Anderson, yet Mel has a style and sound all her own. Whether singing with the energy of a big band or the intimacy of a small jazz combo, she brings a natural feel for the music and a genuine love of every song she sings.

Having performed together on several occasions, Mel recently joined fellow musicians guitarist Doug Anderson, bassist Brock Meades, and drummer Beau Stocker for a live-off-the-floor recording session at Barnhouse Sound Productions in Qualicum Beach. The session captures the energy and spontaneity of the group playing together and is now available on Bandcamp.

Mel currently performs with the Sharp Seven and a variety of smaller ensembles throughout the Comox Valley, Campbell River, and Vancouver Island. Her musical interests centre on jazz, its rich tradition, and the art of bringing great songs to life.

items.name: Mel McCutcheon Ensembles
items.description: Mel McCutcheon performs in a variety of musical settings, from intimate duos and trios to full quartets. These smaller ensembles are well suited to private events, cocktail receptions, elegant dinners, and special celebrations. Whether providing a subtle musical backdrop or stepping into the spotlight, Mel brings together the right combination of musicians and music to suit the occasion.

items.name: The Sharp Seven
items.description:
The Sharp Seven is an established Comox Valley jazz ensemble, fronted by vocalist Mel McCutcheon and featuring a talented lineup of local musicians. Blending warm, expressive vocals with rich instrumental arrangements, the group brings classic jazz standards, swing, blues, Latin rhythms and big-band favourites to life.

The current lineup features Grahame Edwards (bass), Dave Lymburner (trumpet), Michelle Draper (piano), Paul Nuez (trombone), [Beau Stocker](https://www.beaustocker.com/) (drums), and Jack Reynolds (saxophone and flute). With lively interplay and a shared love of jazz, The Sharp Seven entertains audiences throughout the Comox Valley and beyond.

items.name: Vintage Velvet
items.description: Vintage Velvet was a five-piece band built around Mel’s soulful, blues- and jazz-inspired vocals. Blending upbeat, well-loved classics with newer tunes, the band put its own vintage spin on familiar favourites, bringing warmth, soul, energy, and a little nostalgia to every performance.

items.quote: And then came The Mel McCutcheon Quartet. Absolutely incredible. A timeless journey from start to finish. The four of them play so well together. Mel herself is magnetic. Her beauty is the first thing you notice, but it’s her warmth, her wit, and the passion behind her voice that keeps you captivated. She doesn’t just sing, she tells a story, and you feel every word.
items.name: Tamsyn

items.quote: Mel McCutcheon’s voice was absolutely stunning, rich with emotion and clarity, floating effortlessly above the room. The guitar, bass, and drums complemented her perfectly, each musician adding depth and texture while weaving together a sound that wrapped around the audience like a comforting embrace. It was an afternoon of pure musical artistry and heart.
items.name: Kristi W.

items.quote: The music was absolutely amazing, and Mel’s performance was outstanding. She brought so much energy and heart to the stage. The entire show was beautifully done from start to finish. It was a memorable experience, and we’re so glad we were there. Highly recommend!
